content.short: Kelp DAO is a leading liquid restaking protocol on Ethereum that unlocks liquidity for EigenLayer-staked assets.
content.description: Kelp DAO is a premier liquid restaking protocol on Ethereum, designed to enhance the utility of assets deposited into EigenLayer. By allowing users to deposit LSTs like stETH, the protocol issues rsETH, a highly composable Liquid Restaked Token. This enables participants to earn Ethereum staking rewards alongside additional yields from Actively Validated Services (AVS), effectively maximizing capital efficiency. Deeply integrated with DeFi, rsETH can be used as collateral in major protocols, providing users with flexibility while they continue to accrue restaking points and rewards.
content.meta: Kelp DAO provides liquid restaking through rsETH for Ethereum and EigenLayer rewards. Discover Kelp and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
